about: AI-reviewed task-to-skill mapping, 2026-10-31. reviewed:true means the mapping decision has been reviewed by AI, including a decision that no defensible source is present. Generic skills use exact task statements reviewed in the supplied checkpoint report; tool- or method-specific skills require explicit evidence rather than generic occupational tasks. Nothing is selected or excluded based on penetration, automation or augmentation values. A reviewed:false career is intentionally disabled because its occupational proxy is inadequate. No task match means no source, not zero exposure. Legacy O*NET identifiers are retained for source-snapshot compatibility, except that mismatched occupation members are removed. This file does not change the scoring implementation, resolve source missingness, or constitute a full-pipeline rerun. Exact-text rules intentionally require review after source task-text changes.
